# 98.css

The style sheet and fonts of [98.css](https://jdan.github.io/98.css/), version 0.1.21: the files `98.css`, `ms_sans_serif*.woff` and `ms_sans_serif*.woff2` of the `dist/` directory of the npm package `98.css@0.1.21`, with its `LICENSE` (MIT).

They are copied as published and are not edited here. To update, replace them with the files of a later release and change the version above. The site's own rules are in `assets/style.css`.
